fusions.name: Tongue Flick
fusions.desc: A flicked tongue that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles. Anything struck moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Swallowed Whole
fusions.desc: Snaps out at an enemy at or below 20% health, dealing 22 damage, and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Croaking Lure
fusions.desc: A croak that pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Coiled Haunches
fusions.desc: When your stamina fills, your physical damage rises 30% for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
